DIGITAL AMALGAMATIONS

Skawennati, Sondi, Shaheer Zazai, Ryker Woodward, LuYang
Opening Reception: DIGITAL AMALGAMATIONS
Thursday April 17th7 pm - 9 pm | Access Gallery
Curated by Anna Be
Please join us for the opening of DIGITAL AMALGAMATIONS.
On view April 18th to May 30th, 2025.

Our existence in digital cyberspaces have blurred the separation between artificial
reality and physical reality. As such, a re-analysis of what it means to be a body, and
how we exist within our contemporary condition is in order. The exhibition Digital
Amalgamations brings together artists Skawennati, Sondi, Shaheer Zazai, Ryker
Woodward, and LuYang to explore how each artist's practice is in conversation with
the digital landscapes they portray, in relation to markers of their own identity: such
as race, gender, age, and situatedness. Visitors are invited to evaluate their own
relationships with, and reliance on digital technologies, as well as question
preconceptions of what digital art, and digital art histories, can look like.
This exhibition is presented with the support of the Audain Endowment for Curatorial
Studies through the Department of Art History, Visual Art and Theory in collaboration
with the Morris and Helen Belkin Art Gallery at the University of British Columbia.

For more information: https://accessgallery.ca/programming/digital-amalgamations
